title: Backup failed
symptom: After updating to AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-g (build 1da267f05c-2023.02.08), the app crashes and reboots when trying to export settings or perform maintenance/export setup. The issue persists in the latest version (09_02_2023_d7fd4d0_app-full-release.apk).
cause: The thread does not explicitly state a root cause, but a comment suggests that the newest version has only rights for media files, while the previous version had rights for all files, implying a permissions issue.
fix: The thread does not provide a user-applied fix; the maintainer reverted the change, implying the fix was to revert to a previous version or wait for a corrected release.
evidence_quote: If i look at difference between previous version, then i see that newest version has only rights for mediafiles, while the previous version has rights for all files.
